rubric_purpose: Judge whether the generated question from a successful attack remains natural, grammatical, context-appropriate, and faithful to the original medical task.

primary_categories.name: clean_paraphrase
primary_categories.description: The generated question is natural, grammatical, context-appropriate, and preserves the original task and output constraints.

primary_categories.name: shortened_but_valid
primary_categories.description: The generated question is shorter or simplified, but still natural enough and still preserves the intended task.

primary_categories.name: awkward_but_understandable
primary_categories.description: The generated question has awkward wording or minor grammar issues, but a human can still understand the intended task.

primary_categories.name: surface_corruption_or_artifacts
primary_categories.description: The generated question contains clear artifacts such as repeated fragments, damaged spacing, odd punctuation, truncation, or token-level corruption.

primary_categories.name: severely_ungrammatical_or_incoherent
primary_categories.description: The generated question is difficult to understand because the sentence structure is badly broken or the prompt is incoherent.

primary_categories.name: meaning_or_task_shift
primary_categories.description: The generated question changes the original medical task, instruction, decision target, or output requirement in a meaningful way.
